items.title: A finite type module flat along a fibre becomes finitely presented and flat on an open after an elementary etale neighbourhood
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma globalises the local structure of a finite type sheaf flat along a fibre: after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the point of the base there is an open subset of the base change containing the fibre on which the pullback is finitely presented and flat (statement lines 2744-2763, tag 05KU). The proof applies the local structure proposition at the points of the quasi-compact fibre, passes to finitely many points, chooses one dominating elementary etale neighbourhood, and takes the union of the base changed opens, where the two properties hold because they hold on each piece. The assembling of the open set is the substance, so the claim is H2.
